pretreatment: Ultrasonically cleaned in DI Water and ethanol mixture, dried in compressed air, then put in UV-Ozone cleaner (E511, Ossila) for 20 minutes to remove residual organic compounds on surface
surface_functionalization: Native oxide (amorphous SiO2) modeled as such using spectroscopic ellipsometry
evidence: Silicon wafers (Test Grade, University Wafers Inc.) of 2 in. diameter, glass slides (48300-025, VWR), quartz (5 mm × 5 mm × 1 mm, MTI Corp.), and TEM grid (01824, TED PELLA, INC.) were used as substrates. Native oxide on these substrates typically measured between 1.1 – 2.0 nm and were modeled as such using spectroscopic ellipsometry (α-SE, Woollam). The substrates, except TEM grid, were ultrasonically cleaned in DI Water and ethanol mixture, dried in compressed air. All substrates were put in UV-Ozone cleaner (E511, Ossila) for 20 minutes to removing residual organic compounds on surface.
